versions.short: The law changes the 2010 Crow Tribe water rights settlement and updates how the Crow Settlement Fund is managed. It renames and redefines the water and infrastructure projects covered by the settlement, and it repeals an older system-based section of that act. The law lets the Tribe use money from a new projects account mainly to plan, build, repair, and run water and wastewater infrastructure, and it keeps ownership and control of those projects with the Tribe, with no federal duty to pay for their upkeep. It also extends a deadline related to Yellowtail Dam from 15 years to 20 years.
